# Backend Engineer — Clarent Health (fictional, for testing)

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our platform team building the
APIs that power our core product.

## Responsibilities

- Design and maintain REST APIs serving our core product.
- Write and maintain automated tests (unit and integration).
- Collaborate with frontend and product teams on feature delivery.
- Operate and monitor services in production.

## Requirements

- 3+ years of professional experience with Python, ideally with FastAPI or
  Django.
- Strong SQL skills, with production experience running PostgreSQL.
- Experience deploying and operating services on AWS (Lambda, S3, RDS).
- Familiarity with containerization (Docker); Kubernetes experience is a
  plus.
- Experience writing automated tests as part of normal development.
- Comfortable working in a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions or similar).

## Nice to have

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
- Exposure to event-driven architectures (SQS, Kafka).
